G5 bd-01M3DPG4C7D6CCFY5KAZ05KSZ2 remains open on the frozen distributable and documented supported environment. Owner chose an unsigned internal test candidate first; public signing/notarization is a later decision. Human/physical acceptance cannot be replaced by headless tests.
